oversight_bodies.name: Washington State Office of Insurance Commissioner
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Regulates insurance companies in WA. Primary authority over claim denials, bad faith, mental health parity violations, discriminatory coverage.

oversight_bodies.name: Washington State Attorney General - Consumer Protection
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Consumer protection enforcement under RCW 19.86. Escalation route for pattern of insurer fraud or systemic bad faith when OIC does not act.

oversight_bodies.name: CFPB (Consumer Financial Protection Bureau)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Federal jurisdiction for ERISA employer health plans, billing disputes, federal consumer financial laws.

oversight_bodies.name: CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Federal jurisdiction for Medicare Advantage and Medicaid managed care plan denials.

oversight_bodies.name: Seattle Office of Housing
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Primary authority for Seattle housing code violations, illegal lockouts, utility shutoffs. Inspector dispatched within days for urgent complaints.

oversight_bodies.name: King County Code Enforcement
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Primary for unincorporated King County housing code violations.

oversight_bodies.name: WA Attorney General - Renters' Rights Hotline
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Navigation and referral for tenant rights. Not direct enforcement — routes complaints and provides information.

oversight_bodies.name: HUD Fair Housing (Discrimination)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Federal jurisdiction for housing discrimination based on protected class. 1-year SOL from date of discrimination.

oversight_bodies.name: Seattle Office for Civil Rights (SOCR)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: City of Seattle civil rights enforcement. Employment, housing, public accommodation discrimination. Protections include criminal history, military status, gender identity. Covers employers with 1+ employees. Broader than WLAD in some areas.

oversight_bodies.name: WA Adult Protective Services (APS)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Primary state authority for investigating abuse, neglect, and exploitation of vulnerable adults in any setting. 24/7 intake. Investigates within 24-72 hours.

oversight_bodies.name: WA DSHS Residential Care Services (RCS)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Licenses and inspects nursing homes, assisted living, and other residential care facilities. Investigates licensing violations and care standards.

oversight_bodies.name: WA Long-Term Care Ombudsman
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Advocates specifically for nursing home and assisted living residents. Free and confidential. Resident rights, care quality, discharge disputes.

oversight_bodies.name: DOJ Elder Justice Initiative
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Federal escalation for criminal elder abuse, fraud, systematic neglect. Elder Fraud Hotline.

contacts.label: Elder Fraud Hotline
contacts.notes: For criminal conduct or federal fraud

oversight_bodies.name: Washington State Department of Labor & Industries (L&I) - Labor Standards
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Primary WA state authority for wage theft, overtime, minimum wage, final paycheck, equal pay, workplace safety, workers comp. Authority: RCW 49.46, 49.48, 49.58, 49.78, 51.04. WA: 3-year SOL.

oversight_bodies.name: Washington State Human Rights Commission (WSHRC)
oversight_bodies.mailing_address: 711 S Capitol Way Suite 402, Olympia WA 98501
oversight_bodies.authority_description: State civil rights enforcement under RCW 49.60 (WLAD). Employment, housing, public accommodations, credit, insurance discrimination. 6-month SOL (1 year for housing/whistleblower).

oversight_bodies.name: EEOC Seattle Field Office
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Federal employment discrimination: Title VII, ADA, ADEA, Equal Pay Act, GINA, pregnancy discrimination. Work-sharing agreement with WSHRC. File within 300 days (WA). Required before federal lawsuit.

oversight_bodies.name: DOL Wage and Hour Division (WHD) - Seattle
oversight_bodies.authority_description: FLSA violations — federal overtime, minimum wage, child labor. FMLA. H-2A/H-2B worker rights. Federal: 2-year SOL (3 if willful).

oversight_bodies.name: NLRB Seattle Regional Office
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Labor relations violations, union rights, retaliation. File within 6 months of violation.

oversight_bodies.name: WA DSHS Office of Administrative Hearings (OAH)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Administrative hearings for DSHS, L&I, ESD, and 30+ state agencies. Benefits denials, license revocations, agency disputes. Benefits may continue pending appeal if timely requested.

oversight_bodies.name: WA Health Care Authority (HCA) Appeals
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Primary appeal route for Apple Health (Medicaid) denials. File within 90 days.

oversight_bodies.name: WA Employment Security Department (ESD) Appeals
oversight_bodies.mailing_address: 212 Maple Park Ave SE, Olympia WA 98504
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Unemployment insurance denial or overpayment appeals. Appeal within 30 days of initial determination.

oversight_bodies.name: WA Governor's Constituent Services
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Systemic agency failures, non-responsive agencies. Escalate if OAH or agency unresponsive.

oversight_bodies.name: HHS / CMS (Federal Medicaid Oversight)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Federal jurisdiction over systemic Medicaid issues or federal program violations involving federal Medicaid dollars.

oversight_bodies.name: Seattle Office of Police Accountability (OPA)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Investigates SPD officer misconduct complaints. OPA investigates SPD officer conduct.

oversight_bodies.name: WA State Patrol - Internal Affairs
oversight_bodies.authority_description: WSP officer misconduct. File complaint in writing to WSP IA.

oversight_bodies.name: King County Sheriff - Office of Police Ombudsman (OPO)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: KCSO deputy misconduct. Office of Police Ombudsman.

oversight_bodies.name: WA State Criminal Justice Training Commission (CJTC)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Officer certification issues, training violations. Can decertify officers for misconduct.

oversight_bodies.name: DOJ Civil Rights Division
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Pattern or practice of police misconduct/civil rights violations. ADA Title II against state/local government. Voting rights. Education discrimination. Federal jurisdiction — no SOL for DOJ investigations.

oversight_bodies.name: FBI Seattle (Federal Civil Rights)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Criminal referral for civil rights violations under color of law by law enforcement.

oversight_bodies.name: WA Commission on Judicial Conduct (CJC)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Investigates judges statewide for misconduct, bias, ethical violations. Complaints public after investigation.

oversight_bodies.name: WA State Bar Association (WSBA) - Attorney Misconduct
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Investigates attorney ethical violations including GAL attorney misconduct.

oversight_bodies.name: WA DCYF - Complaints about CPS Workers
oversight_bodies.authority_description: CPS worker misconduct or procedure violations. DCYF internal complaint process.

oversight_bodies.name: WA Court of Appeals - Appellate Review
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Appeal of family court orders. Must file within deadlines — seek legal help first.
investigation_powers: Appellate review of family court orders

oversight_bodies.name: Washington State Attorney General - Civil Rights Division
oversight_bodies.authority_description: WLAD enforcement, Fair Chance Act, Healthy Starts Act, Consumer Protection Act, Servicemembers Civil Relief Act. Authority: RCW 49.60, 49.94, 19.86.

oversight_bodies.name: WA Department of Health (DOH) - Complaint Investigation
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Healthcare facility licensing, patient complaints against providers, behavioral health agency licensing. Authority: RCW 43.70, RCW 71.24.

oversight_bodies.name: WA Office of the Ombuds for Behavioral Health Consumers
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Rights advocacy for individuals receiving mental health and substance use disorder services. Investigates complaints against behavioral health agencies. Phone intake; advocacy and referral role. County-level ombuds programs also exist.

oversight_bodies.name: WA Governor's Office of Indian Affairs (GOIA)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Government-to-government coordination between WA State and 29 federally recognized tribes. Tribal consultation, Indian child welfare, tribal sovereignty. Liaison and advocacy role — no formal complaint intake.

contacts.label: GOIA
contacts.notes: Liaison role; no formal complaint process

oversight_bodies.name: King County Office of Civil Rights (OCR)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Housing, employment, public accommodation discrimination in unincorporated King County. Fair housing enforcement. Authority: King County Code Title 12; WLAD.

oversight_bodies.name: U.S. Department of Labor OSHA Region 10 (Seattle)
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Workplace safety and health hazards; whistleblower retaliation; federal employer safety. Note: L&I WISHA handles most private employers in WA. 30-day SOL for most whistleblower claims.

contacts.label: OSHA
contacts.notes: L&I WISHA handles most WA private employers

oversight_bodies.name: U.S. Attorney's Office - Western District of Washington
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Federal civil rights enforcement in Western Washington. Criminal and civil prosecution of civil rights violations. Accepts public reports of non-criminal civil rights violations.

oversight_bodies.name: Indian Health Service (IHS) - Portland Area Office
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Healthcare for Native American and Alaska Native tribal citizens. Access to IHS services. Civil rights within federally funded tribal health programs. Covers WA, OR, ID.

oversight_bodies.name: Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA) - Northwest Regional Office
oversight_bodies.authority_description: Federal trust responsibility. Tribal land issues. ICWA compliance. Tribal enrollment disputes. Tribal governance. Appeals to Interior Board of Indian Appeals (IBIA). Covers WA, OR, ID.
